greeting.text: A messenger from the king? We have done nothing. Please, there must be some mistake.

beware.text: Whatever you carried here is awake, and it will not stop at me. Kill it! And if you live, find Ryn at the shrine; she knew what it was before any of us did.

grateful.text: It is dead. I never thought I would see this square without the fog watching us. Go to the shrine and speak with Ryn: she warned us, and she has been asking for whoever dealt with the thing.
